t: What he said to people who had waited a long time
a: عَلَى رِسْلِكُمْ، أَبْشِرُوا إِنَّ مِنْ نِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ يُصَلِّي هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ غَيْرُكُمْ
p: ʿAlā rislikum, abshirū. Inna min niʿmati-Llāhi ʿalaykum annahu laysa aḥadun mina-n-nāsi yuṣallī hādhihi-s-sāʿata ghayrukum
m: Take it easy. Take the good news. It is part of Allah's favour on you that there is nobody among people praying at this hour except you.
